Element.Description: Target speed on entering patrol. Damage taken toward StunnedHitPoints raises the target speed toward MaxPatrolSpeed.
Target speed while charging and the upper end of the damaged-patrol speed range. AngularSpeed is scaled by current speed divided by this value.
Rate at which current movement speed rises toward the target speed. A lower target speed is applied immediately.
Maximum turning rate in degrees per second at MaxPatrolSpeed, scaled by current speed. Limits both facing direction and alignment to the waypoint surface normal.
Damage required to stun the guardian after entering patrol. Before this amount is exhausted, accumulated damage raises patrol speed from MinPatrolSpeed toward MaxPatrolSpeed.
Target movement speed while stunned. LinearAcceleration controls increases toward this speed.
Stun duration in seconds. Taking another hit while stunned restarts this timer. Return to patrol also waits for the recovery delay to expire and for damage to be enabled.
Charge duration in seconds. Return to patrol after the timer expires also waits for the recovery delay to expire and for damage to be enabled.
